releases.title: Quick Start & Preview Reliability
highlights: Graphical Quick shortcuts target the exact normal application executable; Headless Start targets the matching standalone server executable.
Sync uses the same four final tab names from first render through every navigation change.
Character Preview waits for RSDWModel readiness, reapplies saved appearance and armour, and surfaces renderer errors.
Windows and Linux package workflows produce graphical and standalone headless artifacts.

releases.title: Cloud Directory Connection
highlights: Hosted Sync Worlds self-register with the built-in Cloudflare directory using the launcher's protected Ed25519 operator identity.
The public server browser searches by World name, IP address, or combined search terms.
Connect opens the verified direct-to-host password and synchronization dialog; passwords are never published to Cloudflare.
World Management reports Cloudflare acceptance separately from LAN discovery and local file-transfer state.
The official directory is focused on authenticated Sync Worlds instead of unrelated public Dragonwilds servers.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V3
highlights: LAN discovery and directory publishing continuously renew a running Sync World and self-heal after transient failures.
The WebGUI is a login-only Server Management surface for the active broadcast World.
Sync retries stale transfer routes and replaces mismatched server-owned payloads through rollback staging.
World metadata and reviews are readable before authentication or file transfer.
Character preview resolves local armor and hair models before its first render.
UE4SS and RuneSchema expose separate Baseline, Stable, and Experimental choices; RuneSchema 0.6.2 is retained as the built-in Experimental baseline.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.32
highlights: Dedicated game processes retain a valid hidden Win32 console for UE4SS native initialization without taking focus.
The bundled UE4SS baseline is the exact upstream v3.0.1-1088-ga1e7f571 archive; RuneSchema remains independently managed.
Trash and application popups use themed native taskbar windows.
Detached workspaces say Return to Application and return focus to the existing main window.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.31
highlights: World Start preserves UE4SS console switches; only the explicit Runtime Console setting can change native console visibility.
Failed launch notices prioritize the actual fatal/error lines instead of generic Unreal shutdown lines.
Placard mod inventories and extension popups open as independent themed Windows application windows.
Explicit launcher stop requests are recorded before process-tree termination to distinguish operator stops from game crashes.
A final pre-process writable sweep clears read-only attributes inherited from old profile snapshots or ZIP metadata.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.30
highlights: Runtime self-heal reasserts the active World's selected UE4SS build and RuneSchema flavor before scanning or launch.
Quick Launch and optimized server startup use the same strict profile-runtime guard as normal World management.
Verified selected runtimes refresh the repair library so a stale machine-wide RuneSchema cache cannot return later.
A failed selected-flavor restore blocks launch instead of silently starting against a different RuneSchema DLL.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.29
highlights: UE4SS and RuneSchema Reset can repair the player install, configured dedicated-server path, or both.
Dedicated-server runtime resets preserve profile mods, dwmapi.dll, and the dedicated version.dll loader.
Trash and Notifications open as lightweight draggable native application windows.
Runtime repository selections correctly enable and highlight Delete Selected across the native-window bridge.
Early server exits without stdout recover the current UE4SS/game log tail for actionable diagnostics.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.28
highlights: Detached console tabs, filters, commands, Reveal, close controls, and Export TXT work through the restored native-dialog event bridge.
Immediate lifecycle and failed-start events remain visible in the live Unified Console and exported troubleshooting log.
Early dedicated-process exits report their decimal and hexadecimal exit code plus final captured game-console lines.
Ordinary dialogs use the lightweight themed native host by default while embedded workspaces remain embedded.
UE4SS and RuneSchema each expose Delete and Reset controls that preserve profile-owned mods.
Server mods.txt generation tolerates Windows directory ACLs that deny atomic replacement but permit direct file updates.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.27
highlights: Server launch repairs legacy read-only attributes across UE4SS, RuneSchema, game configuration, runtime caches, profile mod trees, and mods.txt.
Launcher-generated and copied runtime configuration remains writable for the game, loaders, operators, and external editors.
Starting, restarting, updating, or Quick Launching a server no longer navigates to, repaints, opens, maximizes, or focuses the Runtime Console.
The embedded Unified Console detaches into a lightweight themed native host without booting another full application renderer, and DOM updates are batched to avoid repaint storms.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.26
highlights: RuneSchema stages into one canonical AppData runtime root containing config, dlls, enabled.txt, and mods even when an archive has repeated wrapper folders.
Client and server RuneSchema paths use lowercase canonical child directories while retaining case-insensitive compatibility with existing Windows installs.
UE4SS and RuneSchema configuration is restored to writable state after runtime capture, installation, deployment, and client setup.
Large mod archives expose each detected UE4SS, RuneSchema, and PAK payload as a separately selectable and assignable profile import.
Main manifests remain attached to their selected mod payload and unrelated archive content is not installed.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.25
highlights: The complete Runtime Console is embedded in hosted World Management and remains optionally detachable.
World launch and restart no longer create duplicate console windows or polling sessions.
Heartbeat renders retain the live console DOM and unchanged log payloads do not repaint the stream.
UE4SS, RuneSchema, and game root configurations remain writable for their owning runtimes.
A permission-locked optional UE4SS console preference can no longer block server launch.
Settings category navigation retains its shared shell to avoid visible repainting.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.24
highlights: UE4SS Experimental resolves the upstream experimental-latest release asset.
RuneSchema Experimental resolves the newest fork release asset even when GitHub exposes it only as a prerelease.
GitHub tags URLs remain valid manual runtime sources and resolve through the newest tag's attached release.
Runtime channel cards and Trash controls keep complete titles readable at narrow widths.
Helpy adds current redacted application captures and expanded runtime, Sync, profile, and recovery walkthroughs.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.23
highlights: Trash is a compact icon and uses cached, batched restore and delete updates.
Mods owns its page identity instead of inheriting the Settings cover.
UE4SS and RuneSchema expose branded Official and Experimental client channels with working server build libraries.
Save-backed equipped armour remains authoritative when the 3D character model initializes.
Inventory category tabs stay within their panel and route categorized mod items into functional repositories.
The spellbook uses compact radial rune sockets with center page-turn controls.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.22
highlights: Shared panels, forms, buttons, tabs, headers, modals, and action groups now use one consistent spacing and alignment rhythm.
UE4SS, RuneSchema, and RSDW maintenance live together in the Runtime & Data workspace.
Incremental navigation cleanup avoids unnecessary whole-application rescans and repaint work.
Host-wide firewall repair covers every configured gameplay, Sync transfer, Direct Connect discovery, and enabled direct WebHost listener.
Loopback IPC, joining clients, and outbound-only tunnels never receive inbound firewall rules.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.21
highlights: Local, Connected World, and Server Quick Launch use the same authoritative profile pipelines as the full application.
Connected World Quick Launch performs manifest matching, changed-file transfer, parity verification, DragonConnect preparation, and play.
Every Quick role includes the unified source-colored Runtime Console with GAME, UE4SS, RuneSchema, SERVER, and SYNC filters.
Quick starts only role-required background services and promotes into the full launcher without duplicating the backend or runtime.
Resident Quick processes correctly adopt newly opened shortcut profiles, roles, tray targets, and lightweight services.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.20
highlights: Dedicated-server managed resets preserve the colocated dwmapi.dll and version.dll runtime loaders in place.
Retail clients retain independent UE4SS and RuneSchema repair caches that cannot overwrite hosted-server runtime libraries.
Player Settings accepts complete custom UE4SS and RuneSchema ZIPs for regular client and Private World play.
Client runtime repair preserves its selected UE4SS and RuneSchema baselines across profile synchronization.
Server-only version.dll is rejected from retail-client UE4SS imports, and wrapped RuneSchema core archives are recognized correctly.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.19
highlights: All four Sync workspaces retain their selected tab instead of snapping back to Website & Directory.
WebGUI Preview stays mounted during background status cycles and reloads in place on request.
Desktop and Mobile preview controls update without rebuilding the Sync page.
Keyboard tab navigation and idempotent UI observers prevent focus loss and repaint loops.
Dedicated World launch opens a movable unified console with GAME CMD/stdout, UE4SS, SERVER, and SYNC filters.
Dedicated stdout and the active UE4SS log are captured continuously without blocking the launched server.
The GAME CMD and UE4SS filters provide confirmed command input with game-thread dispatch and acknowledgement reporting.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.18
highlights: Website, Helpy, downloads-page, and live Help links use the standalone Dragonwilds-Sync-Web deployment.
Application updates and release downloads remain on the separate Dragonwilds-Sync application repository.
The public server browser uses the live Cloudflare Sync directory without a retired static website snapshot.
Repository-boundary regression checks prevent the website and application authorities from being mixed again.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.17
highlights: Mod change warnings compare gameplay payload instead of server-push and launcher metadata.
Existing fingerprints migrate without creating a one-time wave of false replacement alerts.
Mod Management provides instant search by mod, type, source, and linked profile.
Difference indicators clearly identify actual content differences.
Connected World RSDWL exports keep Worlds and character saves profile-wrapped while always excluding passwords.
Nested mod RSDWL archives and safe per-mod ID.txt consolidation are supported.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.16
highlights: Running dedicated servers continuously supervise and repair their Sync broadcast and file-transfer service.
Local Sync configuration and directory views remain available beside the separate Server Management login.
DragonConnect is restored as hidden baseline infrastructure for hosts and clients.
The WebGUI and default profile artwork now follow the official Sync visual language.
Character Preview reduces high-DPI WebGL rendering cost while preserving saved data and export fidelity.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.15
highlights: Custom RuneSchema flavors are verified by their live DLL hash instead of being rewritten during every launch and publish.
Locked native DLLs are detected before runtime mutation, and optional flavor updates defer without blocking a valid existing runtime from launching.
RSDWTools character/pawn telemetry is authoritative for player counts and map coordinates while log names remain separate account observations.
Player tracking resets between server processes and World sessions so stale identities cannot leak into the active roster.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.14
highlights: Custom RuneSchema flavors are re-applied after runtime repair and shown by their saved names.
Remote Server Login and Quick Launch bind to the exact selected profile ID.
Character Studio preview priority, centered tabs, and Settings alignment are cleaned up.
Retired Microsoft Defender UI is removed in favor of explicit path, manifest, and checksum validation.
Helpy adds subsystem screenshot galleries, refreshed captures, and .rsdwl-first nested-package guidance.
Discord Rich Presence reports fuller World, route, player, health, and workspace context.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.13
highlights: World Configuration is restricted to game/server, UE4SS core, and RuneSchema core settings.
Hosted World profiles retain nameable custom RuneSchema ZIP flavors with an Official GitHub default.
A closable smart mod-import review detects and can override UE4SS, RuneSchema, and PAK archive types.
Player identity reconciliation prefers coordinate-bearing in-game characters while retaining Steam/log names as aliases.
Default Ashenfall calibration restores map plotting, unsupported item bridge commands are blocked, and World actions are consolidated.
DragonCore is not included in baked defaults or bundled archives.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.12
highlights: The launcher-specific RuneSchema variant and bundled archive are removed.
The first server start restores the complete original RuneSchema release from upstream GitHub.
Core DLL, configuration, support files, and enable marker are replaced as one matched unit while child mods are preserved.
Server settings offer the official restore/update action plus an explicit launch-safe manual override for unreleased complete core ZIPs.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.11
highlights: Existing upstream RuneSchema enabled.txt files are preserved byte-for-byte during launch and variant selection.
Read-only upstream enable markers are no longer replaced by the launcher.
A blank UE4SS presence marker is created only when the original is missing.
RSDW Tools update opt-out also preserves its existing enable marker.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.10
highlights: RuneSchema source selection is labeled explicitly as Official Base from GitHub or the Dragonwilds Sync Launcher Variant.
RuneSchema and RSDW Tools remain enabled base mods; their controls toggle automatic updating only.
RSDW Tools update opt-out preserves the installed base mod while keeping its launcher-owned enable marker healthy.
Runtime source and update choices persist across World settings sessions.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.9
highlights: The game receives resolved plaintext WorldPassword and AdminPassword values while encrypted secret references remain in launcher storage only.
A missing encrypted credential now blocks launch with an actionable re-entry message instead of writing an unusable token or blank password.
RuneSchema activation repairs legacy read-only enable markers atomically.
RuneSchema runtime plumbing is excluded from Configuration management while its root configuration remains editable.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.8
highlights: Both possible SteamCMD DedicatedServer.ini trees receive identical WorldPassword and gameplay configuration before launch.
Launch verification fails and identifies paths when any existing dedicated configuration copy remains stale.
Blank discovery, Direct Connect, or editor fields no longer erase a saved working internal or external route.
Routes can still be cleared deliberately through an explicit cleared-routes operation.
Source-contract tests inspect the active V2 implementations rather than compatibility shims.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.7
highlights: Hosts can switch between standard RuneSchema and the extended persistence branch, and clients receive the host's exact selected core.
DedicatedServer.ini is verified at the exact dedicated executable target before launch, including WorldPassword readback.
Connected World Details are offline-safe and incomplete profiles recover their last working Sync route.
Player save recovery retains changed assigned-character saves under the authenticated player profile, separate from administrator quarantine.
Only the same player profile can restore its latest retained save, with local replacement backup and package integrity checks.
Offered World-save snapshots are retained separately on clients for conversion continuity.
Configuration sections are collapsible and limited to game, UE4SS root, and RuneSchema root files.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.6
highlights: Connected World Details open the durable saved profile without requiring a live route.
DedicatedServer.ini updates preserve Dragonwilds-owned ServerGuid and roster fields and leave the file writable by the server.
Each managed gameplay setting, including WorldPassword, is written exactly once in the canonical dedicated-server section.
DragonConnect 0.4.2 performs one delayed password handoff to the completed UMG widget and no longer repeatedly rewrites live fields.
DragonConnect diagnostics identify the exact target widget without exposing the password.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.5
highlights: Active hosted Worlds restart after their canonical World Password is written to DedicatedServer.ini.
DragonConnect commits saved passwords through the live UMG widget rather than display-only reflection.
Connected World Details retain and display the selected saved profile.
Core Configuration excludes individual UE4SS, RuneSchema, and PAK mod files.
Partial LAN/direct refreshes retain the last working route, and damaged profiles recover from their last authenticated endpoint.
WebHost now opens only the authenticated Server Management login and performs no background directory polling.
Hosting Focus appears only for a locally hosted running World and can be dismissed.
LAN and Direct server-finder cards use readable dark controls and framework badges open only their matching advertised mods.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.4
highlights: Connected LAN, Direct Connect, and manual Worlds remain visible in a dedicated Connected Worlds tab.
LAN authentication supports open-World challenge fallback and recognizes clients across multiple host interfaces.
Sync transport defaults to TCP 27051 while gameplay identity remains compatible with UDP 7777.
DragonConnect supports Automatic, Public, and LAN address routing per World.
Character-viewer backdrops load through a constrained Electron asset bridge.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.3
highlights: LAN and Direct Connect save one durable, fingerprint-deduplicated World profile before testing Sync.
Failed authentication or an unreachable host leaves the saved profile visible with a needs-attention result.
Linux LAN scanning no longer elevates privileges or modifies firewall rules.
Heartbeat and directory refreshes use compact bounded requests without bulk artwork or full-state retransmission.
Full World presentation metadata loads on demand instead of through automatic background prefetching.
Server Management remains consistently visible inside Sync for setup and status.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.2
highlights: Direct Connect discovers active Sync Worlds through host-wide UDP 8422 and transfers files through the advertised TCP Sync endpoint.
World Password authentication has pinned-TLS fallback and complete connection-stage diagnostics.
LAN trust, profile/IP access controls, community-rule acceptance, and stable fingerprints govern local joining.
Connected Worlds and default profiles are deduplicated by verified identity.
Quick Launch windows are movable, consistently formatted, and expose reliable progress and heartbeat state.
Firewall, UPnP, forwarding guidance, and WebHost documentation now use distinct authoritative ports.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7.1
highlights: LAN and direct World creation is idempotent, preventing duplicate connected profiles.
Connected profiles retain complete PAK, UE4SS, and RuneSchema summaries through discovery, synchronization, and reloads.
Placard mod-family buttons show the broadcast inventory and cards flip only through explicit controls.
Dragonwilds World Management includes Manifest and populated Local World selection.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.7
highlights: One World Password now protects both client Sync payload downloads and Dragonwilds gameplay, using the active profile as the sole password authority.
Public and LAN discovery preserve complete structured PAK, UE4SS, and RuneSchema mod summaries before joining.
World Sync identifies TCP profile transfer and UDP LAN discovery on port 27051.
World browsing is integrated into Dragonwilds while Mods and Sync management have dedicated application surfaces.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2.6
highlights: Fresh password authentication and manifest negotiation before every Play or Quick Start.
Per-mod/component fingerprints allow unchanged content to remain in place while changed components are transferred.
Real-time mod file edits now replace only the selected mod snapshot and hash, preserving sibling mods, World configuration, Character saves, and profile revision bytes.

Managed UE4SS and RuneSchema updates now resolve official GitHub release ZIP assets through role-specific installers; the Dragonwilds version.dll loader remains dedicated-server-only beside server dwmapi.dll and is excluded from clients.
Windows and Ubuntu release-candidate packaging and verification paths.
WebGUI, catalog, Recommended Mods, RSDW item metadata, and server-management consolidation work.
Native detachable application windows and release-client UI polish.
Revisioned World and feature-worker execution with isolated durable-state authority.
Consolidated current-build documentation and a system-wide phased test matrix.
Combined World Management and Dedicated hosting into the game-icon Dragonwilds Appy while retaining the other navigation icons and routes.
Added Profile Character-save associations with direct RSDW-L editor handoff, guarded startup/Sync operations, editable managed mod files, and an updated in-app walkthrough.
Kept the titlebar and navigation rail mounted across Full-mode renders and added packaged image icons for every Appy to eliminate route-change icon flicker.

Added a 46-subapp regression contract and end-to-end Character Editor/full Item Repository tests; fixed source-launch item fallback, zero-stack validation, and same-second character backup collisions.

releases.title: Dragonwilds Sync V2
highlights: Save-backed World profiles for Singleplayer, Co-Op, and dedicated servers.
World Sync manifests, Direct Connect, directory discovery, and remote administration.
RSDW Toolkit integration for characters, items, spawner, map, and tracking.
Portable Windows launcher baseline.
